caption:
Figure 2: LifecycleSkillBench construction and evaluation. Public tasks, tools, and rules support re-
producible environmental changes, paired affected and capability-retention tasks, and persistent up-
date histories. The evaluated method receives the change description, pre-update Skill, and available
evidence. The evaluator separately stores test tasks, reference outcomes, and recoverable historical
versions, and reports recovery, retention, error propagation, and execution cost.
delegated_acceptance_review: Actually viewed both original and derivative and read caption and independent checks. The purely schematic redesign preserves the four environmental change categories, v1/v2 controls, affected/protected task division, updater-visible versus evaluator-only information, adopted-skill branches to Next update and Evaluate, four joint outcomes and three across-update measures. Text and arrow destinations are unchanged, no empirical evidence requires restoration, and no inferred feedback loop is added.
